messages:
rachel: quick thought 101 1111111111111brainstorm: add a sensitivity simulator to the rollout console. show blast-radius (# users), token cost, and a degradation profile over time when you tweak fallback rules. want feedback.
luis: do you mean multi-trigger policies? e.g. latency>1s AND error_rate>1% with different decay windows? how do we show that on one control?
rachel: yes. panel should let you pick a primary axis (fallback rate, tokens, latency) and layer triggers. we can let ops toggle decay-window comparisons (5m / 15m / 1h).
anika: must-have: an event-replay mode: replay last 6h (sampled) traffic against candidate policy and render a time-series of fallbacks + heatmap by route/region.
infra-bot: heads-up: full replay is heavy. recommend async job: POST /simulations -> job_id. return lightweight preview from a rolling sample (first 5k requests) + link to job for full run.
audit-bot: requirement: persist simulation seed, policy id, policy_version, and dataset-window in audit logs. simulation must be reproducible for postmortem. link to trace ids included.
nate: API debate: sync vs async is the usual. i'd prefer POST /simulations that returns { job_id, preview } where preview contains estimated metrics for UI immediate feedback. long-run results stream via /simulations/{id}/results.
rachel: agreed. preview should include uncertainty bands. show expected fallback pct and stddev for probabilistic rules.
luis: privacy note: prompts in traces contain PII. preview should show redacted prompt by default. add a "request plain" button that requires an approval check (audit-bot).
anika: UX: overlay degrade modes on the same chart (soft-degrade: silence, hard-degrade: failover). colored stacked areas with hover tooltips for token delta and latency p95.
rachel: also add a "what-if" timeline slider: simulate applying the policy at different times and show bobbling due to spikes (helps evaluate sensitivity to bursts).
infra-bot: implementation note: store a compressed index of sampled trace ids to jump to traces quickly. also cap full replays per org/day to limit cost.
audit-bot: include a short blurb in the audit card: "seed: <hex>, policy: auto-fb-v3, dataset: last_6h, sample_rate: 0.02" and link to results. must be immutable.
nate: sample API response for preview:
```
{
  "job_id": "sim-20260701-9a7f",
  "preview": {
    "estimated_fallback_rate": "0.042",
    "fallback_stddev": "0.006",
    "estimated_token_delta": "18340",
    "affected_routes": ["/chat", "/summarize"]
  }
}
```
luis: one more: integrate quota checks into simulator so operators see if fallback will push us over a billing tier (or reduce tokens and thus save). show "expected billing impact".
rachel: +1. and for probabilistic fallbacks show expected draw distribution (mean/median/90pct band) instead of a single number.
anika: ops flow: allow export of simulation as a reproducible artifact (seed + query ids) that SRE can run during incidents.
infra-bot: will add rate limiting and cost-estimates to the backend plan. prefer a single job API that can accept either "light_preview" or "full_replay" param.

rachel: next: i'll mock UI with the overlay and the audit card. nate can draft the /simulations API shape and the error codes. anika pls write the data-redaction policy for sims. luis to add quota/billing hook. tagging folks for a 30m sync tomorrow 09:30.
